summary: All-Stars hero with the tournament trail, three-step selection, summer commitment, required documents, 2026 District 10 dates with BLS results (two titles, 3rd at State), and a link card to the new Champions page.
blurb: How All-Stars works, from selection to the summer schedule, with the 2026 results.

sources.fact: 2026 All-Star teams were posted May 20 to 24, 2026 (first post May 20).
2026 All-Star teams were posted May 20 to 24, 2026 (last posts May 24, softball 10U and 12U).
BLS had 8 teams in the 2026 All-Star tournaments.
2026 Majors (10-11-12) softball All-Stars won District 10, undefeated, and went to State.
2026 Majors softball All-Stars played at the State tournament (opened with a 16-1 win, Jul 5).
